data.name: Hedge Fund Manager Simulator MMO
data.detailed_description:
Gameplay is based on real-world stock markets. If you don't follow them yet, you may feel a bit limited at first, but this is your chance to learn.

Talk is cheap. Now let’s see who can really master the market

This game is a satire of Wall Street and a social experiment, but also a serious test of investing skill.

Start managing your own million-dollar stock portfolio. Sharing your progress is simple, and results are verifiable.

This is the patient investor's trading game

Yes, really. Trading events occur once every trading day. Building a fortune in investing takes time.

You have a million dollars and decide to start your own Hedge Fund

A friendly trading terminal is at your disposal for all aspects of fund management. You can buy, sell and short stocks. Other players can invest in your fund and you can invest in theirs.

Short selling requires the Pro Trader DLC. Otherwise all features are available to all players.

Is the AI bubble about to burst? Short the tech stocks.
Think commercial aviation is ready to climb? Buy airlines.
See a recession on the horizon? Short the Total Market Index Fund.
Hungry for even more risk? Take out a high-interest margin loan.

Build your ideal portfolio and put it to the test against others. You can create a shareable link so anyone can follow your progress. Prove your track record!

Choices matter

Each player controls a single fund, and your fortune depends on it. You can close up shop and start over, but that is the last resort.

As the saying goes: Today is always the best day to start investing. So open up your trading terminal and start managing your very own hedge fund!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz +
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 MB VRAM Intel HD 4000 / GeForce 200 Series / Radeon HD 4000 Series
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection is required to play. Recommended display resolution at least 1280x720
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: 2 GHz +
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 MB VRAM Intel HD 4000 / GeForce 200 Series / Radeon HD 4000 Series
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection is required to play. Recommended display resolution at least 1600x900
